cause.amount_differs: A close entry exists but the amount differs. Usually a fee, a partial payment or an FX difference.
cause.no_candidate: The ledger has nothing like these. Create an entry from each statement line.

cause.resembles: Something resembles these but not closely enough to suggest. Match by hand if you recognise it.

FinanceBanking.causesDescription: Grouped by cause, so a batch is dealt with once rather than line by line.
FinanceBanking.chequeBooksNote: Each cheque book reserves a continuous number range against a bank treasury. Leaves are consumed in order, so a missing number is always visible as a gap rather than reused.
FinanceBanking.chequeDialogDescription: Saving registers the cheque in the register at its opening status. It does not post an entry; that happens as the cheque clears.
FinanceBanking.chequeNotFoundDescription: It may have been recorded under the other register. Pick it from {register}.
FinanceBanking.chequeSaveFailed: The cheque could not be saved. Try again.
FinanceBanking.chequeSaved: Cheque {number} is in the register as {status}.
FinanceBanking.chequeUpdateFailed: The cheque could not be updated. Try again.
FinanceBanking.chequesPostNote: Cheques post to their treasury automatically as they clear. To see the linked journal, open the cheque and follow the source link.
FinanceBanking.createEntryDescription: This posts a balanced entry: the bank side comes from the statement line, the other side from the account you choose. The new entry is matched to the line straight away. It is a real posting, so it is reversible but not deletable.
FinanceBanking.createEntryNote: This statement line has no match in the ledger, so it needs an entry. The bank side is fixed by the statement; choose the account for the other side.
FinanceBanking.createEntryTitle: Create an entry from this line?
FinanceBanking.custodyNote: Custody is cash advanced to an employee against future expenses. It stays as a receivable until the employee settles it with receipts, at which point the spend reclassifies to the relevant expense account.
FinanceBanking.custodySaveFailed: The custody could not be saved. Try again.
FinanceBanking.custodyWriteOffExplainer: Writing off charges the {amount} EGP still outstanding to expense and clears {name}'s custody. Recovering it later needs a new entry.
FinanceBanking.custodyWriteOffFailed: The custody could not be written off. Try again.
FinanceBanking.custodyWrittenOff: {amount} EGP of {name}'s custody was written off.

FinanceBanking.errorBookLeaves: Enter how many leaves the book has.

FinanceBanking.importAllDuplicates: All {count} lines were already imported. Nothing new was added.
FinanceBanking.importConfirmDescription: Imported lines join the unmatched statement list for {account}. Duplicate lines are detected by reference and date and are skipped. Nothing posts to the ledger from an import.
FinanceBanking.importDone: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} imported into {treasury}.
FinanceBanking.importEmptyDescription: Choose the treasury and upload the bank's file. Nucleus parses each line, auto-matches against posted book entries, and flags the rest for manual reconciliation.
FinanceBanking.importFailed: The statement could not be imported. Try again.
FinanceBanking.importNote: Auto-matched lines already correspond to a posted book entry and need no action. The remaining lines open in the reconciliation workspace, where you pair or create the missing entry.
FinanceBanking.importToStart: Import a statement to start reconciling.
FinanceBanking.lastReconciledImport: It was last reconciled on {date}. Import a statement to start the next one.
FinanceBanking.matchConfirmDescription: Matching marks the statement line and the book entry as reconciled against each other. It changes no ledger figure. You can unmatch them again until the reconciliation is finished.
FinanceBanking.matchFailed: The pair could not be matched. Try again.
FinanceBanking.newCustodyDescription: Custody is cash advanced to an employee. Saving records the advance as a receivable — it does not pay the money out.
FinanceBanking.noChequeWithNumber: There is no cheque with this number in the register.
FinanceBanking.noConfidentSuggestion: No confident suggestion for the lines left. Match them by hand, or create an entry for a statement line the ledger has never seen.
FinanceBanking.noCustodyHeldDescription: Advance custody from Employee custody first.
FinanceBanking.noTreasuryWithCode: There is no treasury with this code.
FinanceBanking.onlyBanksDescription: Cash treasuries are counted, not reconciled against a statement. Pick a bank account.
FinanceBanking.onlyBanksTitle: Only bank accounts are reconciled here.
FinanceBanking.payeeHint: The supplier the cheque is made out to
FinanceBanking.postingNoteIssued: Nothing has posted yet. Marking it cleared takes the amount out of {treasury}.
FinanceBanking.postingNoteReceived: Nothing has posted yet. Marking it collected posts {amount} {currency} into {treasury}.
FinanceBanking.reconciliationFinished: {name} is reconciled to {date} ({count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}).
FinanceBanking.registerBookDescription: A book reserves a continuous number range on one bank account. Ranges never overlap, so a number is never reused.
FinanceBanking.settleDescription: Settlement posts the employee's expense claims against the custody and returns any unspent cash to the treasury. The outstanding amount drops by what you settle. Partial settlements are allowed.
FinanceBanking.settleFailed: The custody could not be settled. Try again.
FinanceBanking.suggestedMatches: {count, plural, one {# suggested match} other {# suggested matches}}
FinanceBanking.terminalCancelled: Cancelling voids the cheque for good. It stays in the register as cancelled, and its number is never reused.
FinanceBanking.terminalReturned: Returning hands the cheque back to the drawer. It stays in the register as returned and nothing posts.
FinanceBanking.tooFarApart: Too far apart to match. Create an entry for the difference, or pick another pair.
FinanceBanking.transferEnterAmount: Enter a transfer amount. The amount must be greater than zero. Type how much is moving before posting.
FinanceBanking.transferPostFailed: The transfer could not be posted. Try again.
FinanceBanking.transferPreviewNote: A transfer is one balanced entry: it debits the receiving treasury and credits the sending one. Both totals match, so the ledger stays in balance. Amounts are shown in EGP.
FinanceBanking.transferSameTreasury: Money has to move between two different treasuries. Pick another account on one side.
FinanceBanking.transferShort: {name} holds {amount} {currency}, less than this transfer. Move less, or top it up first.

FinanceClose.acrossTasks: across {count, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}
FinanceClose.adjustmentsMarkedPosted: Adjusting entries are marked as posted.
FinanceClose.adjustmentsNote: Adjustments are manual entries booked during the close — accruals, provisions, and reclassifications. They post to the adjusting window of an otherwise closed period and are tagged for the audit trail.
FinanceClose.closeFailed: The period could not be closed. Try again.
FinanceClose.closePeriodDescription: Closing stops further postings into the period. A controller can reopen it later from Financial periods; the reopen is logged with a reason.
FinanceClose.closePeriodOrderDescription: Periods close in order, and the period under close needs its checklist signed off first. Closing stops further postings into it.
FinanceClose.errorReopenReason: Give the reason. It is logged with your name.
FinanceClose.incomeStatementClosed: FY2025 revenue and expenses are closed into 320101.
FinanceClose.lockFailed: The year could not be locked. Try again.
FinanceClose.lockYearDescription: Locking seals every period in the year. No entry can be posted into it again, and it cannot be undone in this prototype.
FinanceClose.periodIsClosed: {period} is closed. Posting into it now needs a controller to reopen it from Financial periods.
FinanceClose.periodIsClosedBy: {period} is closed by {name}. Posting into it now needs a controller to reopen it from Financial periods.
FinanceClose.periodsNote: Posting is only allowed into open periods. Closed periods can be reopened by a controller; locked periods are permanently sealed after year-end.
FinanceClose.reopenDescription: Reopening lets entries be posted into a period that has already been signed off and reported. Anyone reading the earlier reports will see different figures afterwards. The reopen is logged with your name and reason.
FinanceClose.reopenFailed: The period could not be reopened. Try again.
FinanceClose.stepFailed: The step could not be completed. Try again.
FinanceClose.taskUpdateFailed: The task could not be updated. Try again.
FinanceClose.tasksRemaining: {count, plural, one {# checklist task remaining} other {# checklist tasks remaining}}
FinanceClose.verdictBlocked: This period can't close yet. {incomplete} checklist tasks are incomplete, {blocking} blocking items remain, and {failing} readiness checks are failing. Clear each blocker and sign off the checklist below, then close the period.
FinanceClose.verdictReady: Every task is signed off and every readiness check passes. Close the period to stop further postings to it.
FinanceClose.yearEndWarning: Year-end close zeroes the income statement into retained earnings and locks every period in the year. This is a one-way operation, so complete every step first.
FinanceClose.yearIsLocked: {year} is locked. Every period in the year is sealed and takes no further postings.

FinanceMoneyOut.rejectExplainer: Rejecting sends the bill back to the requester with your reason and removes it from the approval queue. No ledger entry is created. The requester can correct and resubmit it.

advancesExplainer.payable: A supplier advance is a prepayment made before a bill arrives, so it sits as an asset until applied. Applying it against a future bill clears both the advance and the payable.
advancesExplainer.receivable: A customer advance is money received before an invoice exists, so it sits as a liability until applied. Allocating it against a future invoice clears both the advance and the receivable.

noteSaveFailed.receivable: The credit note could not be saved. Try again.

notesExplainer.payable: A debit note reduces what we owe the supplier and can be applied against open bills. Unapplied notes stay on the ledger until offset, so they always tie back to the aging report.
notesExplainer.receivable: A credit note reduces what the customer owes and can be applied against open invoices. Unapplied notes stay on the ledger until offset, so they always tie back to the aging report.

voucherSaveFailed.payable: The payment could not be saved. Try again.
voucherSaveFailed.receivable: The receipt could not be saved. Try again.

writeOffExplainer.payable: A write-off releases the outstanding amount to other income and clears the supplier's balance. It is not a debit note, so the original bills stay as received. Paying the supplier later needs a new entry.
writeOffExplainer.receivable: A write-off charges the outstanding amount to bad debt expense and clears the customer's balance. It is not a credit note, so the original invoice stays as issued. Recovering the money later needs a new entry.
